theme: Two board conversations behind you; one travel decision due before the day turns over.
greeting: Two good governance conversations are already done, Dan — Brunswick this morning and Carol Hansell at one. The day's one real ask left is the December trip: it's your decision date, and the Christmas car is still unbooked.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December break destination
needsAttention.detail: Your Sept 30 decision date for the all-kids Dec 13-Jan 2 trip is here. Books go out by Oct 15 and holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year - pick domestic or refundable-international and commit to one.

needsAttention.title: Reserve the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: This p1 has been open since Sept 14. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market; hold a refundable one now before it sells out, and fix the dates later.

flagged.title: Shawn Maher named his successor
flagged.detail: Your former EY contact replied with his replacement, Didem Nisanci, and flagged her as relevant - the thread is waiting on you.
